texts.value: Involved in the association of MHC class I with transporter associated with antigen processing (TAP) and in the assembly of MHC class I with peptide (peptide loading)

Heterodimer with PDIA3; disulfide-linked. Obligatory mediator for the interaction between newly assembled MHC class I molecules, calreticulin, PDIA3 and TAP. Up to 4 MHC class I/tapasin complexes bind to 1 TAP (PubMed:19119025, PubMed:21263072, PubMed:26611325). Interacts with HLA-G-B2M complex; this interaction is required for loading of high affinity peptides (PubMed:21263072). On its own or as part of MHC class I peptide loading complex, interacts with ligand-free MR1 or MR1-B2M complex, providing for stable MR1 pools ready for metabolite antigen processing (PubMed:32958637)
Neutrophils, mostly in fully differentiated cells
The N-terminus is required for efficient association with MHC class I molecule and for a stable interaction between MHC I and calreticulin. Binding to TAP is mediated by the C-terminal region
The 2 alleles of TAPBP; TAPBP*01 (Tapasin*01) (shown here) and TAPBP*02 (Tapasin*02); are in linkage disequilibria with the HLA-DRB1 locus in a Japanese population

disease.description: An autosomal recessive disorder characterized by glomerulonephritis and markedly reduced cell surface expression of class I HLA antigens. Additional features are herpes zoster infection and polyps of the stomach and colon.
